_meta.note: #713 (#214 Option B with C) rulings on every affix whose harvested tooltip (affix_tooltip.json) matches a STRONG conditional marker in src/affix_tooltip.py. Disposition vocabulary is CLOSED at constant | quarantine | disclose. `evidence` is the shard tooltip VERBATIM and the build fails when the two diverge, when a candidate has no ruling, when a ruling names no candidate, or when a `quarantine` ruling is not carried out by conditional_affix_quarantine.json. A `disclose` ruling carries the `sentence` the post-solve notice quotes.
_meta.precedent: Deific Focus (quarantined in conditional_affix_quarantine.json, #214) is the class this exists to catch before a player does: a ramping, windowed, single-school effect stored as its stack ceiling and offered as a rankable stat.

Dazing.evidence: Dazing IV: On Hit: Your target suffers a -1 Penalty to Will Saving Throws for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times. This effect may only occur on-hit once every three seconds.Passive: The DC of the saving throw to resist your Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist combat feats is increased by 8.
Dazing.label: Dazing IV
Dazing.why: The credited magnitude is the PASSIVE clause — the stat's carriers store the Stunning DC bonus (Buckler of the Demonic Soldier stores 8, the tooltip's 'increased by 8'), which is unconditional. The on-hit -1 Will save debuff that stacks to 5 for 6 seconds is an EXTRA the catalog does not credit at all. Nothing is over-credited.

Sundering.evidence: Sundering V: On Hit: Your target suffers a -1 Penalty to Fortitude Saving Throws for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times. This effect may only occur on-hit once every three seconds.Passive: The DC of the saving throw to resist your Sunder combat feats is increased by 10.
Sundering.label: Sundering V
Sundering.why: Same shape as Dazing: the stored value is the passive Sunder DC bonus (Giant's Fist stores 10, the tooltip's 'increased by 10'); the on-hit Fortitude debuff is uncredited.

Dragon's Edge.evidence: Dragon's Edge 3: +9% Enhancement bonus to bypass enemy Fortification. On Crit: 3d8 Bleeding Damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Dragon's Edge.label: Dragon's Edge 3
Dragon's Edge.why: The passive +9% Fortification bypass is unconditional; the On Crit bleed is uncredited. NOTE (not a conditional question): the stored value is the RANK (3 for 'Dragon's Edge 3'), not the 9% — the Parrying-shaped value-is-a-rank trap, tracked separately.

Improved Deception.evidence: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Improved Deception.label: Improved Deception
Improved Deception.why: The stored magnitude is the unconditional Bluff bonus (the +5 the tooltip states, matching the modal stored 5); the 'while using this item ... chance to envelop the target' proc is uncredited.

Orb Bonus.evidence: +4 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +4 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Orb Bonus.label: +4 Orb Bonus
Orb Bonus.why: The whole bonus is conditional: 'While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking'. The credit stands — a player ranking Orb Bonus is asking for exactly this — and the result says when it applies.
Orb Bonus.sentence: only while the orb is equipped and you are actively blocking
